description: Réseau CVLmobilité - plan de transport théorique ligne A (format GTFS) is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Communauté de Communes Chinon Vienne et Loire. CC Chinon Vienne et Loire, AOM local, organizes a regular public transport line connecting Saint-Benoît-la-Forêt, Chinon, Beaumont-en-Véron, Avoine, Port-Boulet and Bourgueil. The data presents its transport plan (trace, stops, timetables, etc.). Coverage: Communauté de Communes Chinon Vienne et Loire. The portal shows the English title as "CVLmobility network - theoretical transport plan line A (GTFS format)" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Communauté de Communes Chinon Vienne et Loire. Its keywords include transport, gtfs, bus. The listing shows 3 download or service links in GTFS-RT, GTFS. The listing shows 2025-07-06 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/licence-ouverte-open-licence). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
